M08a supplement 01 section 2 (b1, decision 132): with disconnected.co2_shipping_intra_asean = forbid the landlocked LA keeps ONE kind of outlet - the transit corridor to extra-ASEAN storage of decision 93 ('<node> co2 transit export extra-ASEAN', carrier CO2 transit export extra-ASEAN, one per Lao buffered node, kept by every variant): cost = rail land leg to the nearest neighbouring coast on the link (registry co2_lao_transit_land_cost_<node>, 9.66-24.57 EUR2020/t incl. rail loading) + the extra-ASEAN unit cost on LA's own store 'co2 sequestered extra-ASEAN LA' (IEAGHG 2004 shipping chain at 4,500 km incl. liquefaction, harbour, buffer tanks and loading = 24.70 + geological storage 30 = 54.70 EUR2020/t, registry co2_extra_asean_storage_cost_unified) - the same basis as the coastal extra-ASEAN exports; the corridor ends only in LA's extra-ASEAN store, never in the VN / TH national store buses (transit only, no storage in the neighbour). Enforced by m08a_layers.check_landlocked_transit (ValueError / AssertionError otherwise); every country with a captured-CO2 buffer must still reach a permanent sink after b1 (m08a_layers.co2_sink_channels). Convention (INFERENCE, framing only): the right of access to the sea and freedom of transit of land-locked States (UNCLOS Part X, Article 125; GATT 1994 Article V freedom of transit) - the transit state carries the goods, it does not store them; the corridor is kept also when the transit state leaves the coalition (coalition.remove_countries [VN]: the link has both ends in LA)
